Florida PIP Insurance Changes 2025-2026: What Drivers Need to Know

May 22, 2026 · FloridAuto.com

Major Changes to Florida PIP Insurance in 2025-2026

Florida's no-fault Personal Injury Protection (PIP) system is undergoing significant updates in 2025-2026. As a licensed Florida insurance agency since 1966, we've helped thousands of drivers navigate these changes. The new regulations aim to reduce fraud while ensuring fair compensation for injured motorists. Key updates include revised medical fee schedules and stricter documentation requirements for claims.

How This Affects Your Coverage

Florida law still mandates $10,000 in PIP coverage, but the 2025-2026 changes impact how those benefits are applied:

  • Emergency medical treatment still qualifies for full PIP benefits
  • Non-emergency care now requires additional documentation
  • Massage therapy and acupuncture may no longer be covered

Florida-Specific PIP Statistics

Did you know Florida has one of the highest rates of staged accidents in the nation? These PIP changes directly address that issue. Our team at Tomlinson & Co can help you understand how these updates affect your specific situation, whether you need home insurance or auto coverage.
